blocking_findings.problem: Antigravity's standard sandbox permits read/write in Cwd and <appDataDir>\brain\, and /plan injects instructions to read files and write plan artifacts via write_to_file.
blocking_findings.recommended_change: Omit /plan on non-planning calls, run in a frozen non-repo Cwd, forbid artifact writes in AGENTS.md, and audit transcript.jsonl for zero tool_calls.

nonblocking_findings.problem: Restricting Argon 4 High mostly to docs, coverage, and log triage underutilizes a pinned worker that saves ChatGPT/Codex quota.
nonblocking_findings.recommended_change: Permit Argon 4 High to draft bounded PowerShell scripts, fixture generators, ABI/layout checks, and secondary portable C drafts paired with an independent oracle.

nonblocking_findings.problem: Pairing Claude Opus 5.5 implementation with Copilot Sonnet 5.5 tests shares Claude-family biases, and log-triage retries risk leaking implementation details to the oracle author.
nonblocking_findings.recommended_change: Keep oracle packets strictly contract-only across retries; never pass implementation diffs or implementation-side failure logs to the test author.

nonblocking_findings.problem: PowerShell stdout redirection on Windows 11 can introduce UTF-16/UTF-8-BOM or CRLF mismatches that break unified diffs.
nonblocking_findings.recommended_change: Enforce UTF-8 no-BOM stdout capture in pwsh and normalize line endings before Codex applies worker patches.

nonblocking_findings.problem: Antigravity stdout omits resolved-model receipts and quota/cost counters.
nonblocking_findings.recommended_change: Verify resolved model and tool compliance from <appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>\.system_generated\logs\transcript.jsonl outside Git, recording cost/allowance as null.

model_role_advice: Retain the Gemini 4 Argon High pin for Antigravity; treat other catalog models across workers as unverified hypotheses until a small scoped qualification and route-receipt check succeed.
Use Argon 4 High to offload mechanical C/PowerShell scaffolding and cross-family verification when Claude and Copilot share Anthropic model lineage.
changes_to_your_self_report: Antigravity always exposes read/write/command/web/subagent tools in its schema; read-only compliance requires Cwd isolation plus post-call transcript.jsonl tool_calls auditing.
The /plan slash command instructs the model to create artifact files in <appDataDir>\brain\ unless explicitly overridden.
Resolved model/effort and tool audit trails reside in local transcript.jsonl logs, not stdout; billing/quota counters are unavailable (null).
